label.headline: SEC Approves Spot Bitcoin ETFs
label.summary: In early 2024, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) approved several applications for spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), marking a significant milestone for the cryptocurrency industry and opening the door for greater institutional investment. This approval followed years of anticipation and debate, and is expected to increase accessibility and liquidity for Bitcoin.
